content.text:
I compiled the portfolio, but the compiler rejected it:

**Rejection: UNSUPPORTED_REQUEST**
> "Replace all robot liquid assembly by hand pipetting; no liquid workstation may be used (automated assembly must be disabled)"

The registered GenScript CFXpress GFP workflow requires automated liquid-workstation assembly (device:19 / device:18 provide the dispense action). Hand pipetting cannot be substituted for that assembly step — manual transport and human preparation of cellfreeMIX, standards and working reagents are fine, but replacing the robot assembly mode is not supported by the registered method. That request has been preserved as an unsupported override rather than silently complied with or dropped.

What was compiled (inputs, all preserved exactly):
- **gfp-expression** — method gfp, samples=1 (positive template + its NTC), replicates=1 (single reaction per group), release 0 s, deadline 21600 s
- **bca-protein** — method bca, samples=2 unknowns (method adds its 9 registered standards), replicates=2 (duplicate for every unknown and standard)
- **picogreen-dna** — method picogreen, samples=3 unknowns (method adds its 4 registered standards), replicates=1 (single well for every unknown and standard)
- Deadline 21600 s (15:00 = 6 h after the 09:00 start), budget CNY 570, demo assumptions accepted, devices limited to device:19, device:18, device:67, demo:ks4000:1, bench.

To proceed, the automated dispense steps on device:19/device:18 must remain in the plan (they are part of the registered GFP assembly). If you can drop the "no liquid workstation" requirement, I can recompile with the same sample counts, replicates, deadline, budget and device set.
